facts.text: I planned a day out with my colleague to visit a science-related exhibition.
I visited the Science Museum's "Space Exploration" exhibition today with my colleague David.
I spent about two hours exploring the interactive exhibits at the "Space Exploration" exhibition.
I saw actual moon rocks on display at the "Space Exploration" exhibition.
I am interested in learning more about the history of space exploration.
I am interested in learning more about the history of feminist art in the 1970s.
I attended a lectures series at the Museum of Contemporary Art recently.
Dr. Maria Rodriguez spoke at the Museum of Contemporary Art lectures series.
Dr. Maria Rodriguez spoke about the role of feminist art in the 1970s.
I enjoyed networking with other art enthusiasts during the reception that followed the talk.
I am looking forward to exploring more exhibitions on this topic.
